capabilities: Share a file or folder for real-time collaborative editing via a URL
Sync text changes between online peers using a CRDT
Regenerate a share URL if it leaks or servers fail
Run network checks and diagnostics for connection problems
Self-host signalling, STUN and TURN servers
extras: Only syncs Markdown files, so images, Bases and Canvases in shared folders do not sync; recommends the File Recovery core plugin for version history; manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way for multiple people to edit the same note at the same time across separate vaults.

relations.evidence: Collab uses Yjs to sync text over the WebRTC protocols.
Trystero lets us use public Nostr servers for signalling.

requires.name: TURN relay account (e.g. ExpressTURN) only when direct peer connections fail

summary: Peer-to-peer collaborative editing plugin that syncs shared files and folders across vaults in real time with end-to-end encryption.
